I develop open-source R packages for problems at the intersection of
biostatistics, public health, and clinical informatics. My current work
focuses on genomic surveillance methodology, algorithmic fairness in
clinical AI, and privacy-preserving data generation for multi-site
clinical research.

## R Packages on CRAN

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
:::: {.card}
### [lineagefreq](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lineagefreq)

Modelling pathogen lineage frequency dynamics, estimating growth
advantages, and generating short-term forecasts from genomic
surveillance count data. Five estimation engines (frequentist and
Bayesian) behind a unified interface, with built-in rolling-origin
backtesting. Ships with real CDC SARS-CoV-2 surveillance data.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lineagefreq) |
[GitHub](https://github.com/CuiweiG/lineagefreq) |
[Docs](https://cuiweig.github.io/lineagefreq)
::::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
:::: {.card}
### [survinger](https://cran.r-project.org/package=survinger)

Design-adjusted inference for pathogen lineage surveillance under
unequal sequencing and reporting delays. Implements Horvitz–Thompson,
Hajek, and post-stratified estimators with Wilson score intervals;
right-truncation-corrected delay distributions for nowcasting; and
Neyman-optimal resource allocation.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=survinger) |
[GitHub](https://github.com/CuiweiG/survinger) |
[Docs](https://cuiweig.github.io/survinger)
::::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
:::: {.card}
### [clinicalfair](https://cran.r-project.org/package=clinicalfair)

Post-hoc fairness auditing for clinical prediction models.
Computes group-stratified performance metrics with bootstrap
confidence intervals, detects four-fifths rule violations,
visualises calibration and ROC disparities, and performs
threshold-based mitigation. Model-agnostic and aligned with
FDA AI/ML guidance.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=clinicalfair) |
[GitHub](https://github.com/CuiweiG/clinicalfair) |
[Docs](https://cuiweig.github.io/clinicalfair)
::::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
:::: {.card}
### [syntheticdata](https://cran.r-project.org/package=syntheticdata)

Generating synthetic clinical datasets with integrated privacy
auditing. Implements Gaussian copula, bootstrap, and Laplace noise
synthesis, with built-in distributional validation, membership
inference testing, attribute disclosure risk assessment, and
downstream model fidelity comparison. Designed for HIPAA/GDPR-constrained
data sharing.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=syntheticdata) |
[GitHub](https://github.com/CuiweiG/syntheticdata) |
[Docs](https://cuiweig.github.io/syntheticdata)
::::
:::
